luke.3.p1.b1.text: In the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, while Pontius Pilate was governor of Judea,

luke.3.p1.b3.text: during the high priesthood of Annas and Caiaphas,

luke.3.p1.b4.text: the word of God came to John son of Zechariah in the wilderness.

luke.3.p2.b1.text: He went into all the region around the Jordan, preaching a baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins,

luke.3.p2.b2.text: A voice of one calling in the wilderness, ‘Prepare the way for the Lord, make straight paths for Him.

luke.3.p2.b3.text: Every valley shall be filled in, and every mountain and hill made low. …

luke.3.p2.b4.text: And all humanity will see God’s salvation.’”

luke.3.p3.b1.text: You brood of vipers, who warned you to flee from the coming wrath?

luke.3.p3.b2.text: For I tell you that out of these stones God can raise up children for Abraham.

luke.3.p3.b3.text: The axe lies ready at the root of the trees, and every tree that does not produce good fruit will be cut down and thrown into the fire.”

luke.3.p4.b2.text: “Whoever has two tunics should share with him who has none, and whoever has food should do the same.”

luke.3.p4.b3.text: Collect no more than you are authorized

luke.3.p4.b4.text: “Do not take money by force or false accusation,” … “Be content with your wages.”

luke.3.p5.b1.text: The people were waiting expectantly and were all wondering in their hearts if John could be the Christ.

luke.3.p5.b2.text: One more powerful than I will come, the straps of whose sandals I am not worthy to untie.

luke.3.p5.b3.text: He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and with fire.

luke.3.p5.b4.text: His winnowing fork is in His hand to clear His threshing floor and to gather the wheat into His barn; but He will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.

luke.3.p6.b1.text: With these and many other exhortations, John proclaimed the good news to the people.

luke.3.p6.b2.text: But when he rebuked Herod the tetrarch regarding his brother’s wife Herodias and all the evils he had done,

luke.3.p6.b3.text: Herod added this to them all: He locked John up in prison.

luke.3.p7.b1.text: When all the people were being baptized,

luke.3.p8.b2.text: and the Holy Spirit descended on Him in a bodily form like a dove.

luke.3.p8.b3.text: “You are My beloved Son; in You I am well pleased.”

luke.3.p9.b1.text: Jesus Himself was about thirty years old when He began His ministry.

luke.3.p9.b2.text: He was regarded as the son of Joseph,

luke.3.p9.b4.text: the son of Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel,

luke.3.p10.b1.text: the son of Nathan, the son of David, the son of Jesse,

luke.3.p10.b2.text: the son of Obed, the son of Boaz,

luke.3.p10.b3.text: the son of Isaac, the son of Abraham,

luke.3.p11.b1.text: the son of Shem, the son of Noah,

luke.3.p11.b2.text: the son of Seth, the son of Adam,

luke.3.p11.b3.text: the son of Adam, the son of God.
